hero-pairs-b09-short-01-001.text: Ho a tjhesa. Moahlodi o bitsa phomolo ya metsi kgafetsa.
hero-pairs-b09-short-01-001.en: Hot enough that the ref's calling a water break every ten minutes.

hero-pairs-b09-short-01-002.text: Kushushu kakhulu: usompempe ubiza ikhefu lamanzi rhoqo.
